description: Autonomous team leader that drives an epic to completion by breaking it down, delegating to AI sub-agents (engineers, researchers, architects), and enforcing quality with holistic coherence review. Use when asked to "lead an epic", "drive this epic", "manage this epic end-to-end", "run this epic", "take charge of", "own this epic", or "deliver this epic". Also use when handing off an epic for autonomous execution with quality enforcement, or when the user wants a team of agents to collaboratively complete a large work item. Do not use for individual task execution — use jit-manage for that.
method: dev/eval/skill-triggers/run_trigger_eval.py (adapted skill-creator trigger-eval technique; base-name match instead of unique-proxy match, see README.md)
